name_story.story: Edina can be understood through the Arabic form عَدِينَة, whose central sense is edina; eden (balkan form). Edina is the Bosnian form of Arabic عَدْن (ʿAdn), the Quranic name of the gardens of Eden.

faq.a: Edina is associated with the Arabic form عَدِينَة, whose core sense is edina; eden (balkan form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Edina?
faq.a: Edina is associated with Arabic. Edina is the Bosnian form of Arabic عَدْن (ʿAdn), the Quranic name of the gardens of Eden.
Yes — the underlying form عَدِينَة is Arabic.
Edina can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Edina should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAdn occurs in the Quran as the name of the gardens of Eden.

faq.q: What does Edina mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Edina is rendered عدینہ and carries the sense عدینہ، جنت.

faq.q: What does Edina mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Edina is rendered عدینه and carries the sense عدینه، عدن.
A romanized syllable approximation is e-di-na. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Edina?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Edina, edina. Script forms are عدينه, عدینه, عدینہ, عَدِينَة, एदीना.

faq.q: Is Edina a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
